name: mentor
$note: An older, calm mentor (male): a slightly smaller head, a longer and leaner face, narrow tired eyes under heavy lids, a composed mouth and sleek swept-back greying hair. Shows an expression list (a pose word, then an own amount: the lids a third closed), the graphic face words for the lids and the brows, and a silver streak highlight on the fringe alone (toon.light.highlight, kind streak).
